tools.name: search_effects
tools.description: Find RapVideoAI video effects: viral AI trend videos and dances (car alarm dance, Gangnam Style, hug videos, aging filters...), plus personalized rap and sung songs (birthday, love, Christmas, pet rap) that turn the user's own photos of themselves, a partner, friends or a pet into a short video. Use

tools.name: get_effect
tools.description: Show one RapVideoAI effect: what it makes, its versions (e.g. solo, with a friend, four of you), the people and photos each version needs, its length and price in credits, and the user's balance when signed in. Use it after search_effects, before make_video.

tools.name: make_video
tools.description: Make a RapVideoAI video from the user's photos. It spends the version's credits from the user's RapVideoAI account (a failed video gives them all back). Before calling: 1) pick the effect and version with get_effect, 2) tell the user the price in credits, 3) ask for exactly the photos that version a

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Check a RapVideoAI video started with make_video: its status, minutes left and, when ready, the link to the finished video. With wait true the call waits up to 40 seconds for it to finish; call again while it is still processing.

tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.description: List the user's latest RapVideoAI videos (newest first) with their status and links.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the signed-in RapVideoAI account's first name and credit balance. Use it before make_video when the price might be more than the user has. Credits are bought on rapvideoai.com/pricing; an assistant cannot buy them.

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Make a link (valid 30 minutes) where the user adds the photos for a video on rapvideoai.com from any device. Use it when the user cannot attach photos in this chat. When they say they are done, call make_video with the upload_id.

tools.name: suggest_effect
tools.description: Send RapVideoAI a trend or idea that has no effect yet, so the team can add it. Use it when search_effects finds nothing that fits.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "make_video" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Make a RapVideoAI video from the user's photos. It spends the version's credits from the user's RapVideoAI account (a failed video gives them all back). Before …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
